title: MobSouls
description: Adds MobSouls that can be crafted with heart of the sea and the mobdrop witch give special abilities
body:
MobSoulsPlugin is a Minecraft PvP plugin where players can collect and equip souls from different mobs, each granting unique passive effects and a special ability activated with /ability.

Souls & Passives

🧟 Zombie — Resistance
🏹 Skeleton — Haste
🕷️ Spider — Dolphins Grace
💥 Creeper — Speed
🔥 Blaze — Fire Resistance
👁️ Enderman — Strength

Abilities (/ability)

🧟 Zombie — AOE melee slam around you and does 3 hearts, heals you for 3 hearts
🏹 Skeleton — Fires a burst of 10 armor-piercing arrows
💥 Creeper — Launches a fast armor-piercing fireball that explodes on contact
🔥 Blaze — Unleashes 30 mini fireballs over 3 seconds
👁️ Enderman — Teleports you forward up to 15 blocks
🕷️ Spider — Launches you forward in the direction you're looking

Soul System

Craft souls using mob drops surrounding a Heart of the Sea
Right-click to equip — swapping gives your old soul back into inventory
/souldrop to unequip your soul
Souls drop on death only when killed by a player
All ability damage ignores armor
